text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD67890 fired: route=runtime-inference-eu latency_p95>1200ms for 3m, service=inference-runtime, urgency=high :rotating_light:
andrew: acked oncall. I'm on it. Checking dashboards + recent deploys.
maria: i see a small spike on the router cpu and a larger tail at the decoder layer. correlates with higher qps from a single customer pool.
jonathan: no recent deploys in EU, last build was 2h ago. pulling logs now.
ops-bot: autoscaler bumped pool-inference-eu from 12->18 pods at 15:03 UTC (policy: burst), pod startup latencies ~45s.
andrew: thanks. can we temporarily widen routing to fallback-eu2 for new requests? that should smooth p95 while autoscale warms.
katrina: routing policy change ready: `curl -X POST https://router/api/v1/routes/balance -d '{"route":"inference","weight":{"eu":70,"eu2":30}}'` — i'll apply in 30s unless objections.
maria: +1, do it. also enabling kv-cache warmup for the busiest model shard (shard-7) to reduce decoder coldstart token overhead.
jonathan: logs show repeated 503s from worker-7 at the decoder step starting ~14:58 UTC, concurrent connections ~620 (baseline 300). looks like a customer burst.
andrew: applied routing change. monitoring p50/p95 now. api-dashboard: p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 380ms within 70s. nice.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD67890: acknowledged by andrew at 15:05 UTC.
ops-bot: KV-cache warmup job started for shard-7 (job id: warmup-3412).
maria: warmup is reducing token generation latencies, decoder queue depth down 40%.
jonathan: sanity check on error budget: no customer-facing 5xx increase; upstream timeouts transient. looks like degraded latency only.
andrew: good. i'll keep monitoring for another 10m. if stable i'll resolve PD.
katrina: do we want to page customer-success to let them know about an internal mitigation? low-customer-impact.
maria: i'd hold; no visible impact in telemetry (no SLO breaches), just higher tail latencies for a small percentage of traffic. we can notify if it reoccurs.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD67890: AUTO-RESOLVE at 15:08 UTC (duration 5m).
andrew: marking as no-customer-impact, transient customer pool burst + cold kv-warmup.
jonathan: saving logs + timeline to the incident board: `/incidents/pd67890` with initial triage notes.
ops-bot: autoscaler stabilized at 16 pods (target), no further surges.
katrina: passing to next oncall for follow-up (hand-off): @maria you're on the handoff?
maria: taking follow-up. action items: 1) confirm cause of customer burst (CS and infra logs), 2) add opportunistic kv-warmup when shard load > 400, 3) add a short-lived rate smoothing at router for single-customer spikes.
andrew: agreed. i'll create a quick PR for the router smoothing rule and a pager threshold tweak so similar bursts don't page immediately.
jonathan: note: add a metric for shard decoder queue depth alert to reduce noisy pages that auto-resolve.
maria: will coordinate with CS for customer contact if we see repeated bursts.
andrew: closing thread; PD auto-resolved but leaving follow-ups assigned. thanks all :thumbsup:
